relations: Vero 与 Luca（真名 Aaron）：敌对，施刑者与被纸割囚徒——Vero「He is zip-tied to a chair in the corner of Cipher’s shed.」；Vero 自述已割到「Forty-nine」刀还在往上加

Vero 与 Kayla：恋人/伴侣（Vero 称之为「my paper-cut princess」）——Aaron 指控她利用人，Vero 反问「She never mentioned you to me. I know about her other ex-boyfriend—she talked about him, but I guess you didn’t leave that big of an impact.」
Aaron（自称 Luca）与 Kayla：前任加害者与受害者——Aaron 说「She used to beg me for it.」「She has a scar inside her left hip.」；Vero 指出「You put her in a fucking box in the ground, and she still made it out.」
Vero 与 Brawley：伴侣（恋人）——Vero 称 Brawley 为自己的 boyfriend：「My boyfriend would kill you, and he would make it a lot more painful.」
Cave 与 Cipher：Vero 认定的恋人关系——Vero 问 Cave「Do you have a thing for him?」「You do. I like him.」「I don’t like him like that—he is all yours.」，Cave 以低吼回应

facts.fact: Vero 用纸片一刀一刀割被绑在 Cipher 棚屋椅子上的 Luca，边割边计数，数到「Forty-nine」并称手腕内侧「very productive」
facts.anchor: Forty-nine. The inside of the wrist is very productive

facts.fact: Aaron 对 Vero 断言 Kayla 一贯利用人，Vero 不接受，说那是 Aaron 自己编出来的版本
facts.anchor: She was using you. She uses everyone; she always has.

facts.fact: Vero 揭穿 Aaron 并不知情：Kayla 被他连人带箱埋进土里后仍然活着出来了
facts.anchor: You put her in a fucking box in the ground, and she still made it out.

facts.fact: Aaron 警告 Vero「You know what you are」，Vero 承认自己很清楚自己是什么、也远比常人更有的时间思考
facts.anchor: You know what you are and what happens when

facts.fact: Vero 拿起 Cipher 工作台上的螺丝刀捅进 Aaron 的肩膀，音效让他兴奋；随后又把手伸进伤口
facts.anchor: It plunges into his shoulder, and the sound he makes is the best since we have been here

facts.fact: Aaron 说 Kayla 过去常求他施暴，Vero 立刻用纸片在他脸上划出一道
facts.anchor: She used to beg me for it.

facts.fact: Vero 向 Cipher 讨要纱布与酒精，明确说不想让 Aaron 现在就死，Cipher 从抽屉里取给他
facts.anchor: I wanted to see if you had some gauze or something because this one is deeper and I don’t want him to die just yet.

facts.fact: Cipher 起身外出为所有人买吃的，Vero 追加要求要「nuggets」并要一样含糖的东西
